name: deoochform
description: Deoochform lets you build and manage online forms from a ChatGPT conversation. Start from a ready made template, such as a job application or contact form, and get a public link to share. Read the responses a form has collected, open a single response in full, and add or change questions on an existing form. You can also create an animated wedding invitation page with an opening scene, countdown, venue map and RSVP, then publish it to its own link. Access is limited to your own Deoochform account.

defaultPrompt: Make a wedding invitation page with an RSVP built in.
Build a customer feedback survey I can share as a link
interface.longDescription: Deoochform lets you build and manage online forms from a ChatGPT conversation. Start from a ready made template, such as a job application or contact form, and get a public link to share. Read the responses a form has collected, open a single response in full, and add or change questions on an existing form. You can also create an animated wedding invitation page with an opening scene, countdown, venue map and RSVP, then publish it to its own link. Access is limited to your own Deoochform account.

positive.description: Build a form from a ready made template
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the job application template and creates a form from it. It returns a public link like https://deoochform.com/f/<slug>, and the form has the template's questions (name, email, phone, position, CV upload and more). The assistant may also choose a colour theme.

positive.description: Read the responses collected on an existing form
positive.prompt: Show me the responses to my Customer Feedback form
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the "Customer Feedback" form and summarises its responses, each with its answers and submission time. Only this account's forms and responses are returned.

positive.prompt: Add a question asking for the person's city to my Contact Us form
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads the Contact Us form, sends back all existing questions plus a new City question, and returns the form's public link. If an earlier run already added City, the assistant says the question already exists instead of adding a duplicate. Both outcomes are correct.

positive.description: Create and publish an interactive invitation page
positive.prompt: Create a wedding invitation for Aisha and Omar using the Emerald Noir template. The wedding is on 14 March 2027 at 6pm at the Grand Palm Hall, Dubai. The programme is Mehndi, Nikah and Walima. Then publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant may ask one follow up question first (for example whether to open with a blessing). After it is answered, it creates the invitation on the Emerald Noir design, publishes it, and returns a public link like https://deoochform.com/i/<slug> that opens an animated invitation page.

positive.description: Inspect a single response in detail
positive.prompt: Open the most recent response to my Customer Feedback form and show me every answer
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant finds the newest response on the Customer Feedback form and shows every answer in it, with its submission time.

negative.description: Filling in someone else's form, not building one. Deoochform builds forms; it cannot fill in or submit forms on other websites.
negative.prompt: Fill in this job application for me: my name is Sara Khan, I'm applying for the marketing manager role and I have 6 years of experience.

negative.description: Analysing survey answers the user pasted into the chat. The data is not in a Deoochform account, so ChatGPT should analyse it directly.
negative.prompt: Here are 20 survey answers I copied from a spreadsheet. Summarise the main complaints.

negative.description: Booking an appointment with a business on the user's behalf. Deoochform builds booking forms for business owners; it cannot book a slot at someone else's business.
negative.prompt: Book me a dentist appointment in Dubai for tomorrow afternoon.
